output_list.code: function buy() payable public {        require(!closeBuy);        uint amount = msg.value / buyPrice;        uint market_value = amount * buyPrice;        uint commission = market_value * 4 / 1000;        if (commission < minimumCommission){ commission = minimumCommission; }        address contr = this;        require(contr.balance >= commission);        commissionGetter.transfer(commission);        _transfer(this, msg.sender, amount);    }
